fields.name: NSSAI inclusion mode IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for NSSAI inclusion mode

fields.name: NSSAI inclusion mode
fields.description: Indicates the NSSAI inclusion mode: 00=mode A, 01=mode B, 10=mode C, 11=mode D

notes: The NSSAI inclusion mode information element is a type 1 information element
NSSAI inclusion mode (octet 1, bit 1 to bit 2): Bits 2 1 - 0 0: NSSAI inclusion mode A, 0 1: NSSAI inclusion mode B, 1 0: NSSAI inclusion mode C, 1 1: NSSAI inclusion mode D
